title: OnlySigned Phase 1 Frontend Foundation & Navigation Shell

requirements.summary: Introduce an app shell with Layout/Header/Footer and client-side navigation, including admin-only navigation visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: The app renders a consistent header/footer on all pages.
Navigation links switch between pages without a full page reload (client-side navigation).
The Admin link is hidden for non-admin users and visible for admin users.
The previously empty component files `frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx`, `Header.tsx`, and `Footer.tsx` are implemented (without modifying any immutablePaths).

file_operations.description: Implement a reusable Layout that renders Header, a main content outlet/slot, and Footer with consistent spacing/surfaces across the app. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a top navigation header with links to Home, Profile, Assets, Collections, Marketplace, Messages, and Admin; render Admin link only when the current user is admin. Include login/logout controls using Internet Identity context and clear React Query cache on logout per authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a footer with basic site links (e.g., Privacy, Support) and Phase 1 foundation messaging; ensure it renders on all pages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hook(s) to support role/admin checks needed by the Header (e.g., query for isCallerAdmin and/or caller role) using the generated actor bindings; ensure safe behavior when logged out. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a client-side router configuration that maps required pages to paths and composes them under the Layout to enable navigation without full reloads.
Replace HomePage-only rendering with the router-driven app shell so all routes render within Layout while preserving existing React Query and Internet Identity providers.

acceptanceCriteria: All listed placeholder page modules render non-empty UI (no blank screens).
Navigating to each page shows a title and description in English.
No runtime errors occur when visiting any page while logged out or logged in.

requirements.summary: Update Home page for Phase 1 foundation: remove backend-incomplete destructive alert and add an onboarding status panel while preserving II login and profile create/edit via existing hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page no longer displays the destructive alert text: “Backend Implementation Required”.
When logged out, the Home page shows a clear login call-to-action.
When logged in, the Home page shows the principal string and whether a profile exists.
When a profile exists, the UI indicates whether the user is admin based on returned profile data.
Profile create/update continues to work using existing React Query hooks (`useGetCallerUserProfile`, `useSaveCallerUserProfile`).

file_operations.description: Remove the destructive “Backend Implementation Required” alert and replace it with an onboarding-friendly status panel (login status, principal when logged in, profile exists/doesn’t exist, admin status when applicable) while preserving Internet Identity login/logout and profile create/update via existing hooks. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent, distinctive non-blue/purple visual theme across the app shell and Phase 1 pages using existing Tailwind OKLCH tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: App has a consistent, intentional look across header, footer, and pages (not default/unstyled).
Primary actions, cards, and navigation states have consistent styling.
The chosen theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary brand colors.

file_operations.description: Update OKLCH design tokens (especially --primary/--ring/--accent and related sidebar/chart tokens) to a distinctive palette that is not blue/purple, and add any minimal global base styles needed for consistent surfaces/typography.
Apply the updated theme consistently to navigation states (active/hover), header surfaces, and primary actions using existing Tailwind classes and token-based colors.
Apply the updated theme consistently to footer surfaces, typography, and link states using existing Tailwind classes and token-based colors.
Ensure the Layout applies consistent page spacing and background/surface styling aligned with the updated token theme.

acceptanceCriteria: Files exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` matching the imageRequirements filenames.

The app includes a favicon referencing the generated favicon asset.
